mapper.select: SELECT j.* FROM user_memory_job j JOIN agent_run r ON r.id=j.run_id AND r.user_id=j.user_id AND r.status='SUCCEEDED' JOIN agent_message q ON q.run_id=r.id AND q.role='USER' JOIN user_memory m ON m.user_id=j.user_id AND m.enabled=1 AND m.version=j.memory_version JOIN user u ON u.id=j.user_id AND u.status=1 JOIN space s ON s.id=r.space_id AND s.deleted=0 JOIN space_member sm ON sm.space_id=r.space_id AND sm.user_id=j.user_id WHERE j.attempts < 3 AND ((j.status='PENDING' AND j.next_attempt_ms<=#{now}) OR (j.status='RUNNING' AND j.lease_until_ms<=#{now})) ORDER BY j.run_id LIMIT 1

SELECT j.*,q.body AS question FROM user_memory_job j JOIN agent_run r ON r.id=j.run_id AND r.user_id=j.user_id AND r.status='SUCCEEDED' JOIN agent_message q ON q.run_id=r.id AND q.role='USER' JOIN user_memory m ON m.user_id=j.user_id AND m.enabled=1 AND m.version=j.memory_version JOIN user u ON u.id=j.user_id AND u.status=1 JOIN space s ON s.id=r.space_id AND s.deleted=0 JOIN space_member sm ON sm.space_id=r.space_id AND sm.user_id=j.user_id WHERE j.run_id=#{id} AND j.status='RUNNING' AND j.claim_token=#{token} AND j.lease_until_ms>#{now}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_memory_job j LEFT JOIN agent_run r ON r.id=j.run_id LEFT JOIN agent_message q ON q.run_id=j.run_id AND q.role='USER' LEFT JOIN user_memory m ON m.user_id=j.user_id LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id=j.user_id LEFT JOIN space s ON s.id=r.space_id LEFT JOIN space_member sm ON sm.space_id=r.space_id AND sm.user_id=j.user_id SET j.status='DISCARDED',j.claim_token=NULL WHERE j.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING') AND (r.id IS NULL OR q.id IS NULL OR r.status IN ('FAILED','CANCELLED','TIMED_OUT') OR m.user_id IS NULL OR m.enabled=0 OR m.version<>j.memory_version OR u.id IS NULL OR u.status<>1 OR s.id IS NULL OR s.deleted<>0 OR sm.user_id IS NULL OR (j.attempts>=3 AND j.lease_until_ms<=#{now}))
